title: Arriving in Los Angeles and joining Johnny Mitchell
summary: He reaches Los Angeles on Thanksgiving 1925 and gets his first job with Johnny Mitchell at the Italian Village, with a list of band members.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: I arrived in Los Angeles on Thanksgiving Day, 1925 to play great with the Sunnyland Band. For certain reasons I did not play with that band, so my first job was with Johnny Mitchell and the cafe downtown L.A., called the Italian Village.
Johnny was the leader on sax, Kenny Prince on piano, Les Hite, sax, Lionel Hampton, drums, myself on trumpet and a banjo player, I don't remember his name.
I stayed with Johnny until May, 1926. I played with Kencan Henry, Frank, Little Cotton Club, jobs, casuals, in Los Angeles and San Francisco.
